notes: Very poorly documented in open sources. Vela-Apaza 2024 (src 0): present in the Madre de Dios river floodplain plots Cocha Lobo and Jacaratia (seasonally flooded c. 23 days/yr) but nearly absent from the Los Amigos plots; patchy/clumped. Atrium specimen (src 1), Los Amigos Biological Station, Trocha Bajio, floodplain forest, 270 m: 'Tree 10 m. Calyx green. Fruit orange.' - height and fruiting month are this one tree. No species description, leaf data, phenology or frugivore source was found; POWO (blocked, not used) is where search snippets placed its range (W South America to N Brazil).
